errata.why: FORGE section 4.2, structural result: a quota binds only if you can name principals and prevent free creation of principals. Under stdio local-first there is exactly ONE OS principal (client and server are the same user), session creation is free by design (each turn, each reconnect, each server process), and even a server-signed token does not help because the server would issue one to whoever asks. So no per-subject quota can bind in v1 without changing the deployment posture, which docs/02 defers. The bound must therefore move from the SUBJECT to the OBJECT: per engram, per wall-clock window - keyed on what a caller cannot mint. FORGE section 4.3: 'Under local-first stdio, Magicite's achievable integrity guarantee is temporal, not authenticational.' These object-keyed bounds are not v1 stopgaps: they survive into the deferred served profile, composing with per-tenant authorization rather than being replaced by it. A security claim a reader relies on and that does not hold is worse than an absent one.

errata.trigger: ATLAS confirmed BY EXECUTION that author-declared edges (needs->depends_on, composes, inhibits) carry exactly zero activation mass, permanently, and that no code path can ever raise them: route() at spec defaults and route() with every declared type_gain AND inhib_gain zeroed return BIT-IDENTICAL scores to 12 decimal places, while forcing a declared S_edge=0.9 does change the ranking - the path is live, it is never fed. Mechanism: storage/durable.py:203 inserts declared edges at storage_strength=0.0 and the ON CONFLICT clause updates only dst_id/dangling so re-sync never raises it; core/dream.py:194 + core/signals.py:152-164 mean Dream can only potentiate co_activation, the sole type ever tagged; core/activation.py:56 then DROPS edges with w<=0, so declared edges are ABSENT from the graph rather than weak.
errata.why_this_is_a_spec_defect_not_a_bug: spec.md:593 section 3.3 step 10 derives plan_confidence from S_edge over plan edges. Plan edge types are depends_on/composes, always provenance='declared', and Dream potentiates only co_activation - so mean(S_edge) is a STRUCTURAL constant and plan_confidence is permanently 0.0 for every multi-node plan. It is client-visible (core/router.py:378,395 -> mcp/schemas.py:150 -> mcp/bind_retrieval.py:66). The spec asked for something unsatisfiable as written; no patch can fix that without a spec decision. Secondarily, apply_inhibition (core/activation.py:144-167) is a numeric no-op (a_i *= 1 - 0.0*0.7 = 1), so AC-023 is UNREACHABLE IN PRODUCTION - it passes only because tests/unit/core/test_router.py:80 injects storage_strength=0.8 by direct SQL.
errata.counter_argument_engaged: storage/durable.py:304-309 documents the 0.0 as deliberate - 'a declared edge encodes intent and must still be learned (Dream, M4) before it carries weight ... weight is earned, not assumed'. That is a coherent design position and it is NOT dismissed: the amendment preserves it verbatim for the channel it was always about (edge.storage_strength, the Hebbian channel, still starts at 0.0 for a declared edge and is still Dream-only). What it is not is a defence of the current state: the mechanism by which a declared edge would EARN weight was never built, and M4 has shipped. The strongest evidence for oversight over intent is that the codebase diagnosed this same failure mode THREE times and worked around it locally each time - core/registry.py:60-71 (_COMMUNITY_WEIGHT_FLOOR=0.1), core/router.py:14-25 (structural hub PageRank), eval/bench.py:70-78 (baseline (c)) - all sharing the premise 'inert UNTIL Dream/M4 exists', while nobody patched the three places where the same zero is load-bearing.
errata.what_changed: spec.md gains a new normative subsection 3.3.1 'Effective edge weight': S_eff(edge) = max(edge.storage_strength, w_authored(edge)), where w_authored = declared_edge_strength (new magicite.toml knob, default 1.0) for provenance='declared' and 0.0 for learned/derived/distilled. Computed at READ, never stored - no column, no second migration, no checkpoint field - so AC-009/AC-010 are untouched (pinned by new AC-036) and Dream's decay/prune/renormalise still operate on the learned column alone. Floor, not replacement: learning may exceed an assertion, it may not erase one. Range-preserving (S_eff in [0,1]) so 1 - S*inhib_gain stays positive. Exactly revertible at declared_edge_strength=0.0 (new AC-039). One pure helper core/edge_weight.py::effective_strength, guarded by a new AST criterion (AC-040). Amended call sites: section 3.3 step 4 (W_ij = S_eff * type_gain), step 5 (a_i *= 1 - S_eff*inhib_gain, S_eff DIRECTLY since type_gain['inhibits']=0.0 by design), step 9 (cycle-break becomes a total order (S_eff, dep_name, dependent_name) - it previously degenerated to dict iteration order because everything tied at 0.0), step 10 (plan_confidence redefined structurally), section 2.6 step 9 (community weights: S_eff replaces max(S_edge,0.1); _COMMUNITY_WEIGHT_FLOOR deleted), introspect edge rows (additive effective_strength field), eval/bench.py baseline (c) (same helper with the learned channel suppressed). DELIBERATELY NOT changed: the hub-penalty structural PageRank (measured to help, +0.0286 Hit@1; whether it should be learned-topology-weighted is an open experiment), Dream's phases, wire_declared_edges, the DDL, and the 16-tool surface.
errata.plan_confidence_fix: section 3.3 step 10 WAS mean(S_edge over plan edges) * (resolved_deps/declared_deps), which was unsatisfiable. NOW plan_confidence = |E_sat|/|E| (1.0 when |E|==0), where E is every declared depends_on/composes edge whose src is a node in the emitted plan (dangling INCLUDED) and E_sat are those that resolve, whose target appears in `order`, and whose ordering `order` respects. The S_edge factor is REMOVED rather than floated to 1.0: it can only ever be a constant under any future in which Dream's tagging is unchanged, so it carries no information in either regime. All three ways a plan is actually untrustworthy fall out of one rule with no extra constants - dangling target fails clause 1, depth/size-cut target fails clause 2, cycle-broken edge fails clause 3. Deliberate behaviour change: the len(order)<=1 -> 1.0 short-circuit is gone, so a lone winner with two unresolvable needs now reports 0.0 - the honest answer, and exactly the case the short-circuit hid. Pinned by AC-037/AC-038.
default_changes: ppr_restart 0.15 -> 0.85. MEASURED (70 engrams / 210 pre-registered queries, one Config field at a time, arm-invariant): Hit@1 0.4619 -> 0.5476 (identical to embedding baseline (b)'s 0.5476), Hit@3 0.7000 -> 0.7476 (ABOVE (b)'s 0.7429), MRR 0.5913 -> 0.6398. At 0.15, 85% of activation mass diffused along the 350 derived similar_to kNN edges and the PPR term contributed 37% as much ranking spread as similarity - spread reflecting neighbourhood mass, not query match. WHY NOT w_activation=0, which measures 0.0048 Hit@1 better (0.5524): inhibition acts ONLY on the activation vector, so zeroing that weight makes AC-023 arithmetically UNPROVABLE - you would break a frozen criterion to buy one query in 210 - and it would turn 45% of the score into a constant zero, taking the hub penalty and community rerank with it.

w_retrieval 0.15 -> 0.05 and w_similarity 0.30 -> 0.40, labelled PRECAUTIONARY PENDING FURTHER EXPERIMENT and NOT a measured optimum. The justification is an evidence-balance asymmetry, not a new magic number: 0.15 has ONE strong measurement against it (under an oracle teacher on a MATCHED train/test distribution, held-out Hit@1 fell 0.4697 -> 0.1061, a 3.6x collapse; it degrades on its own training split too, 0.4583 -> 0.2847; the target-only variant with zero learned edges still collapses to 0.1818) and ZERO measurements ever FOR it. Mechanism measured: w_similarity*cosine spread 0.0561 vs w_retrieval*R spread 0.0354 = 63% of the query-conditioned signal's amplitude, contributed by a pure usage-frequency prior with zero query conditioning. Honest limit carried: the workload is uniform, which makes a popularity prior maximally uninformative. w_activation (0.45) and w_excitability (0.10) unchanged; the four still sum to 1.00. Reverse on evidence if component normalisation recovers cold-level held-out Hit@1 at 0.15.

errata.ruling_vs_forge: ADOPTED on substance, SHARPENED on mechanism, with one site withheld. Adopted: declared mutual exclusion and composition are AUTHORED ASSERTIONS, not earned Hebbian weights. Sharpened: (1) the category error was the CONFLATION of two semantics in one column, not the 'earned' principle itself - so the amendment keeps 'weight is earned' true of S_edge and adds a named authored channel rather than declaring the principle wrong; (2) a FLOOR, max(S_edge, w_authored), not FORGE's 'fixed gain independent of S_edge' - learning may exceed an assertion, it may not erase one, and this also keeps S_eff in [0,1] so 1 - S*inhib_gain stays positive; (3) scope is all authored edge types, not just inhibits, since fixing inhibition alone would leave composes/depends_on dropped from the graph and plan_confidence at 0.0. FORGE's arithmetic objection to a floor is ANSWERED rather than accepted: it is an objection to the magnitude 0.1 (inherited from _COMMUNITY_WEIGHT_FLOOR, ~2.7% of graph mass), not to the form - at the authored magnitude 1.0 the same arithmetic gives ~21.7% of global mass and, since W is row-normalised, ~36-53% of a declared node's own outflow. WITHHELD: the hub-penalty structural PageRank keeps type_gain-only weighting; it is the one graph mechanism measured to help (+0.0286 Hit@1, +0.0362 MRR) and whether it should be learned-topology-weighted is FORGE's own open D3 experiment - consistency is not worth an unmeasured change to a measured-good component. REJECTED alternative (preserve 'earned' and make declared edges EARNABLE instead): there is no observable whose accumulation makes 'A inhibits B' more true (co-activation is evidence AGAINST it); it leaves every freshly-authored registry routing as if the author had declared nothing; and it is strictly larger work. The earnable path is NOT closed - the floor form already lets a potentiated declared edge win - it is deferred as CF-3.

errata.decision: declared_edge_strength SHIPS AT 1.0, confirmed on the evidence rather than merely retained. The measurement is one weak measurement against 1.0 and none for it, which is the same evidence-balance shape that moved w_retrieval 0.15 -> 0.05 - and the answer is that the principle as stated in DECLARED-EDGES-AMENDED section 7.2 has three qualifiers ('the downside it guards against is catastrophic; the upside it forfeits is unmeasured; the change is one config line') and this case fails all three. w_retrieval: 3.6x collapse (0.4697 -> 0.1061), mechanism measured, nothing structural forfeited. declared_edge_strength: 6 queries in 210, mechanism NOT identified, and reversal forfeits three shipped behaviours plus one addendum criterion.
errata.decisive_finding: The re-measurement contains an ACCIDENTAL ISOLATION that was not read out, and it is decisive. Baseline (c) carries declared composes/depends_on into the diffusion graph at FULL authored mass (eval/bench.py:198-208, _GRAPH_EDGE_TYPES weighted by effective_strength_no_learned(..., cfg.declared_edge_strength) * type_gain) and carries NO inhibition (inhibits is not in _GRAPH_EDGE_TYPES and _baseline_c_rank never calls apply_inhibition), NO community rerank, NO hub penalty, NO R, NO excitability - it is 0.6*PPR + 0.4*cosine and nothing else. (c) is 0.5286 in BOTH arms: 111 of 210, IDENTICAL. So putting full declared-edge mass into the activation graph changed ZERO of 210 top-1 answers. The -6 in (d) therefore cannot be attributed to call-site rows 1 or 3, and must arise in a channel present in (d) and absent from (c): INHIBITION (row 2) or the COMMUNITY RE-CLUSTERING (row 3). Two mechanisms, two different knobs, and the run separated neither - which is exactly what MO-3 was written to obtain. Lowering declared_edge_strength would damp a channel measured INERT in order to treat a channel NEVER ISOLATED. Caveat recorded against my own key argument: (c)'s invariance could alternatively be a harness artefact if the (c) arm did not pick up the config override; whoever runs RC-1 must confirm (c) responds to the knob at all before concluding anything from its invariance.
errata.uncalibrated_interaction_found: inhib_gain = 0.7 PREDATES this amendment (DECLARED-EDGES-AMENDED section 11 lists it as deliberately unchanged) and was set when an inhibits edge's S was expected to be a LEARNED value distributed over [0,1]. Call-site row 2 pins S to the TOP of that range for EVERY authored inhibits edge and, uniquely among the call sites, uses S_eff directly without type_gain (because type_gain['inhibits']=0.0 by design). The shipped multiplier is 1 - 1.0*0.7 = 0.3: a 70% cut of the inhibited node's activation from one unweighted line of author YAML. inhib_gain HAS NEVER BEEN CALIBRATED FOR S=1.0. It is the most plausible mechanism for a six-query regression and it has its own dedicated knob - which is DELIBERATELY NOT TOUCHED here, because moving it on an unisolated six-query delta would be the identical methodological error at a different address. This is a second instance of CF-5's failure mode: a constant calibrated against one implicit distribution, silently re-pointed at another.
errata.statistical_standing: A net swing of 6 in 210 has a MAXIMUM ATTAINABLE exact-binomial (McNemar) significance of p = 2*0.5^6 = 0.031, and only in the degenerate case where all six discordant pairs run one way; with as few as four discordances the other way (n01=10, n10=4, n=14) it is p = 0.180. The b-d gap this spec previously acted on was 18 queries at p = 0.00053. No paired test was run here and the ceiling on one is marginal - so the honest characterisation is not 'probably not significant' but 'marginal in the best case and non-significant under any realistic discordance pattern'.

Only plan_confidence survives, and only because section 3.3 step 10 was redefined STRUCTURALLY - core/composition.py confirms _closure walks declared edges regardless of S_eff, and S_eff enters only as the cycle-break sort key where the (S_eff, dep_name, dependent_name) total order stays deterministic even when every candidate ties at 0.0, so AC-042 holds either way.

errata.negative_product_finding: RECORDED AT FULL STRENGTH, not softened. FORGE ruled H-BODY-b 'falsified as implemented, UNTESTED AS DESIGNED' precisely because declared edges carried zero mass; that condition is now discharged. The result: at FULL authored mass, declared composes/depends_on in the activation graph changed ZERO of 210 top-1 answers in the isolated arm (c), and the full pipeline (d) was WORSE by six queries. The best (d) has ever measured - 0.5476, exactly tying dense baseline (b) - is measured with declared edges OFF. H-BODY-b therefore remains falsified as implemented and is now additionally NOT SUPPORTED AS DESIGNED on the only corpus that exists: zero supporting measurements, two non-supporting ones. What the amendment DID deliver and this run does not touch: plan_confidence is a real satisfiable ratio instead of a permanent client-visible 0.0 (AC-037/AC-038); inhibition is reachable from register() rather than only from direct SQL (AC-034); cycle-breaking is deterministic instead of dict-iteration-ordered (AC-042); one weighting site instead of three divergent local workarounds (AC-040). None of those four is a retrieval-accuracy claim. The amendment fixed a correctness and coherence defect; it has NOT been shown to improve routing, and a release note must state those two things separately and the second without hedging.
errata.was_the_amendment_wrong: NO - and the falsifiable form of that answer is recorded rather than asserted. plan_confidence was unsatisfiable as the spec wrote it (a structural constant reaching clients as a confidence number); AC-023 was unreachable by any production path; three divergent local workarounds patched the same zero. All three are defects independent of any benchmark, and the first is fixed independently of declared_edge_strength entirely. What IS now in doubt is NARROWER and named exactly: the claim that authored edges belong in the DIFFUSION GRAPH (call-site rows 1 and 3) has zero supporting measurements and one measured 0/210. If RC-3 also returns null that specific claim should be RETIRED - mechanism kept, implemented and opt-in, declared_edge_strength = 0.0 shipped, AC-035 restated. That is RC-3's decision rule and it does NOT require RC-2 to reach significance.
reversal_conditions_pre_registered: RC-1 (= MO-3, already owed): declared_edge_strength=1.0 with inhib_gain=0.7 vs inhib_gain=0.0, everything else fixed, same corpus and queries. RULE: if the inhibition arm accounts for the whole -0.0286 or more, the defect is the INHIBITION MAGNITUDE, not the authored channel - re-derive inhib_gain, leave declared_edge_strength at 1.0. If it accounts for none of it, the residual is the community re-clustering and call-site row 3 is what gets revisited. Also confirm (c) responds to the knob at all.

RC-2: a SECOND, INDEPENDENTLY-AUTHORED registry (engrams and queries by different authors) plus a PAIRED McNEMAR test on (d) at 1.0 vs 0.0. RULE: if (d) at 1.0 is worse at p < 0.05 paired, declared_edge_strength ships at 0.0 - mechanism stays implemented, verified and opt-in - and AC-035 is restated to name a non-zero strength in its GIVEN. The addendum is not frozen; the frozen 33 are untouched either way.

RC-3 (= CF-7): a COMPOSITIONAL query set - H-COMPOSE is still UNTESTED, zero compositional queries have ever been run - scored on a composition-sensitive metric that is not a monotone re-encoding of Hit@1. RULE: if declared mass does not improve it there either, the diffusion channel has NO measured benefit on ANY metric and should ship off by default regardless of RC-1.

RC-4: any registry whose declared relations are KNOWN-GOOD BY CONSTRUCTION. Removes the confound that this corpus's needs/composes/inhibits were authored by the same agent that wrote the queries, so a null here may be measuring poor input rather than the design.
errata.corpus_limits_carried: The 210 queries are SINGLE-TARGET retrieval queries - three per engram, one gold answer each. Diffusion along a CORRECT needs/composes edge moves activation from the target toward its dependencies, which are by construction NOT the gold answer, so on this metric a correct composition edge can only be neutral or harmful. FORGE's ruling that H-COMPOSE is UNTESTED still stands (zero compositional queries; Plan F1 as implemented is a monotone re-encoding of Hit@1). This is a real limit and it is DELIBERATELY NOT USED AS A SHIELD: it is converted into RC-3 with a decision rule attached. The single-authorship confound is RC-4. Recorded as insufficient: re-running the SAME corpus with more queries - it shrinks the error bar on a measurement whose confound is not statistical.
options_rejected: LOWER TO AN INTERMEDIATE VALUE (0.3, 0.5): no point between the endpoints has been measured and both endpoints have; interpolating toward the better endpoint without evidence re-introduces the second magnitude knob underneath type_gain that DECLARED-EDGES-AMENDED section 4.3 rejected on exactly these grounds, and damps the INERT channel and the SUSPECT channel together in unknown proportion.

SHIP THE MECHANISM AT 0.0, OPT-IN: reverts three defects the amendment exists to fix, makes AC-035 false at the shipped default and thus forces a tests/ change, and is justified by a delta whose channel is not isolated and whose significance ceiling is p = 0.031. LOWER inhib_gain NOW: right suspect, wrong time - there is ZERO direct evidence on it because the isolation was never run. It is RC-1.
REVERT THE AMENDMENT ITSELF: rejected; see was_the_amendment_wrong.

errata.decision: inhib_gain 0.7 -> 0.245. THE QUESTION WAS CORRECTLY SPLIT BY THE ORCHESTRATOR into 'is 0.7 defensible' and 'what replaces it', which have different evidentiary standards; conflating them is what produces argmax-chasing.
errata.why_0_7_is_not_defensible: (a) PARETO-DOMINATED BY FOUR OF THE FIVE ALTERNATIVES SWEPT. 0.7 = (109, 154, 0.6227) is worse than 0.0, 0.1, 0.2 AND 0.3 on Hit@1, Hit@3 and MRR SIMULTANEOUSLY, and is the WORST value in the sweep on both Hit@3 and MRR. Only 0.5 fails to dominate it (109 > 107 on Hit@1) and 0.5 is itself dominated by 0.3. This is the load-bearing statement because it is METRIC-INDEPENDENT and ARGMAX-INDEPENDENT, and it is a WITHIN-SWEEP comparison - the design in which the single-author confound CANCELS ACROSS ARMS (the same property that made the ppr_restart sweep acceptable evidence; FORGE rated that measurement type E-2, reliability H, for exactly this reason). The confound attacks absolute levels and argmax selection; it does NOT attack dominance ordering. (b) IT NEVER HAD ANY EVIDENCE FOR IT, IN ANY REGIME - the decisive asymmetry. Until DECLARED-EDGES-AMENDED, apply_inhibition was a NUMERIC NO-OP (confirmed by execution to twelve decimal places), so inhib_gain=0.7 was a plausible-looking constant IN A DEAD CODE PATH, never measured against anything ever. Its first exposure to measurement Pareto-dominates it away. 'Do not change on weak evidence' protects incumbents that EARNED standing; it is not a licence to keep whatever is currently written down. (c) THE MIS-CALIBRATION IS DIAGNOSABLE FROM THE DESIGN'S OWN CONSTANTS, WITHOUT ANY CORPUS. theta_synapse=0.35 is the strength at which an edge becomes a GENUINE SYNAPSE (core/dream.py:503,515 - candidates below it, or with evidence_count<3, are excluded from synapses:). So for a LEARNED inhibits edge the intended effect S*inhib_gain ranged over [0.35*0.7, 1.0*0.7] = [0.245, 0.7], from 'just became a synapse' to 'maximally reinforced'. Section 3.3.1 pins S_eff=1.0 for EVERY authored inhibits edge on DAY ZERO, so an assertion with NO accumulated evidence whatsoever was granted the effect reserved for a maximally-potentiated, sustained-evidence synapse.
errata.replacement_derived_not_selected: inhib_gain = theta_synapse * inhib_gain_learned = 0.35 * 0.7 = 0.245. An authored assertion enters at the magnitude the design assigns to an edge that has JUST become a genuine synapse - the BOTTOM of the intended range, not the top. A declared inhibits now scales the inhibited node's activation by 1 - 1.0*0.245 = 0.755 (was 0.3). DELIBERATELY NOT ROUNDED TO 0.25: the un-round figure is the audit trail - 0.245 is visibly derived, 0.25 would look tuned. If theta_synapse ever moves this is RE-DERIVED, not re-tuned. WHY THIS IS NOT THE OVERFITTING THE SPEC HAS TWICE REFUSED: the magnitude comes from theta_synapse and the original inhib_gain, BOTH of which predate the amendment and NEITHER of which came from this corpus. The corpus's role is CORROBORATION, NOT SELECTION - 0.245 falls between the swept points 0.2 and 0.3, both on the constrained Pareto frontier, and is the ARGMAX OF NOTHING. Taking the MECHANISM from the corpus (established robustly at 84%) while taking the MAGNITUDE from the design's own constants is the only construction a single-author corpus cannot contaminate.
errata.zero_is_forbidden: inhib_gain = 0.0 is FORBIDDEN, not merely worse - AND IT IS THE CORPUS'S OWN Hit@1 ARGMAX. At 0.0 the pass computes a_i *= (1 - S*0) = 1, so AC-023's 'strictly lower' and AC-034's 'strictly lower than at declared_edge_strength=0.0' become arithmetically UNPROVABLE - not failing, unprovable. This is the identical argument that rejected w_activation=0 for a 0.0048 Hit@1 gain: 0.0048 Hit@1 is noise, a frozen criterion is the tamper-evidence anchor. It would also ship an 'inhibition' mechanism that does not inhibit - the dead-mechanism state DECLARED-EDGES-AMENDED exists to end. NOTE WHAT THIS DOES: it is a NON-CORPUS CONSTRAINT that excludes the corpus's own Hit@1-maximising answer. Without it, the Hit@1 data alone would have argued for 0.0, and following it would have been the argmax error in its purest form.
options_rejected: SHIP 0.7 UNCHANGED AND LET RC-2 SETTLE IT: considered seriously - the orchestrator explicitly offered it and was not fishing. Rejected because CONSISTENCY REQUIRES APPLYING THE SAME TEST, NOT RETURNING THE SAME ANSWER. R12-FIRED's test: is the mechanism identified? does the value have prior standing? what does reversal forfeit? For declared_edge_strength - mechanism NOT identified, value DERIVED from an existing knob, reversal forfeits three shipped behaviours -> KEEP. A prediction confirmed is stronger than a claim asserted - AND IT IS ALSO THE SHAPE A MOTIVATED REASONER PRODUCES, since naming a mechanism in advance makes any subsequent confirmation feel decisive. So the scepticism handed forward is explicit: THE DERIVATION IS THE PART TO ATTACK. inhib_gain_authored = theta_synapse * inhib_gain_learned treats the PRODUCT S*inhib_gain as the calibrated quantity and reads theta_synapse as the entry point of the intended range.
